Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.

retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 10 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge. The English article, at revision 1370278966, argues the revolt out of the 1864 land reforms and shrinking peasant holdings and forward to the agricultural-contracts law of 23 December 1907 and the leasing law of 12 April 1908, and this atlas holds no Romanian record of any kind and neither law. It names nothing this corpus has: not the Russian revolution of 1905, not the Balkan wars, not the First World War. It waits on a Romanian neighbour, and no fetch supplies one.
